name: brand-role-promotion-consistency
title: Keep account roles and BrandMembership scope consistent
description: Separate system account roles from BrandMembership authority, prevent incompatible assignments, and design a safe promotion/demotion workflow.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Immediate guards are implemented. A future atomic transition mutation must preserve the employee's operational role when demoting from Brand manager to staff and must handle multi-Brand memberships explicitly.
